title: Thunderbirds Come to the Rescue in Ukraine
description: BROLL of an apartment fire in downtown L'viv, Ukraine. Soldiers with the Oklahoma Army National Guard’s 45th Infantry Brigade Combat Team, deployed to Ukraine in support of the Joint Multinational Training Group-Ukraine, rushed into the burning building and evacuated the third floor before local firefighters arrived on scene.
